items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: But Andrew Morgan, he played with his Young Morgan Band. That's with Andrew Morgan and Jim.

ctx.x: And when did Henry Ross come into picture? He claims that he played with Morgan Band too. Was that in the later years too? Well I don't know.
It might have been the later years, but I knew young Morgan had a band. You see now, young Morgan Band had Jim on trombone, his nephew Jim Little on bass, Rudolph John Drum, and Andrew Morgan.
This must have been the band that Henry Ross played with. Yes, they might have played with that group, you see.

items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: we'd use the Andrew Morgan... At the paddock with us, the relief band.

ctx.x: And Emma and Rick Howe played. Yeah. Then when Piku stood there, then when Piku, I think Piku's out of getting feeling kind of bad. He used to alternate. He'd be with his wildest faces, you know. Sometimes we couldn't get Piku where we might use the answer and then we'd use the Andrew Morgan. Piku?
